findings_raw.description: The code uses a fixed timeout interval for polling the Replicate API, which does not adapt to the expected completion time or system load, potentially causing unnecessary requests or delayed response.
findings_raw.remediation: Implement an exponential backoff strategy or use a webhook-based notification system to avoid fixed-interval polling.

findings_raw.description: Identical requests for image generation (same imageUrl, theme, and room) are not collapsed, leading to redundant work and increased load on the Replicate API.
findings_raw.remediation: Implement request collapsing by caching promises for identical requests so that concurrent requests for the same input share the same prediction.
